content.title: Monte-Carlo SFs: Schedule, who is playing, how to watch & more | ATP Tour | Tennis
content.text: Alcaraz, Sinner, Zverev & Vacherot all in action April 10, 2026 Corinne Dubreuil/ATP Tour Court Rainier III at the Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters. By ATP Staff The Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters semi-finals take place on Saturday, with Carlos Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner leading the action at the ATP Masters 1000 event. Here is what you need to know about the semi-finals in Monte-Carlo: When are the 2026 Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters semi-finals? The 2026 Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters semi-finals will take place on Saturday, 11 April. Second seed Jannik Sinner will face third seed Alexander Zverev not before 1:30 p.m. local time (CEST) and top seed Carlos Alcaraz will play home favourite Valentin Vacherot not before 3:30 p.m. Who is playing in the 2026 Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters semi-finals? The Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters semi-finals will feature Jannik Sinner against Alexander Zverev and Carlos Alcaraz playing Valentin Vacherot. What are the 2026 Rolex Monte-Carlo Masters semi-final H2H records? Jannik Sinner takes an 8-4 Lexus ATP Head2Head lead into his match against Alexander Zverev, having won the pair's past seven tour-level matches. Carlos Alcaraz and Valentin Vacherot's Monte-Carlo clash will be their maiden tour-level meeting.
